meta.purpose: Study-5 pre-registration power/feasibility; frozen before ANY Study-5 data generation (2026-07-10).
meta.additive_note: this study5 entry point is ADDITIVE; the default Study-4 run and power_study4.json are byte-unchanged.

d_xl_hlang2_direction_power.family: XL — H-LANG-2 cross-language invariance on an EXTERNAL corpus of certified program-language pairs (single test, confirmatory; the Study-4 Family-L NOT_CONFIRMED verdict stands as recorded)
d_xl_hlang2_direction_power.estimand: one-sided 95% percentile-bootstrap lower bound on Cliff's delta_XL (aligned j=k vs cross j!=k) > 0; per-pair primary stratum from the frozen XL roster category->stratum map (configs/xl_roster.json, data-independent, frozen pre-mutant); n pairs -> 5n cells, aligned n, cross 4n
d_xl_hlang2_direction_power.machinery: power_analysis_study2.power_cliffs (identical to the power_study4.json H-LANG entry), n_sim=10,000, inner bootstrap 400, master seed 20260708
d_xl_hlang2_direction_power.achieved_n_rule: if the §2c certification gate excludes pairs, the achieved power is READ OFF this frozen n=12/10/8 curve — no post-data simulation
d_xl_hlang2_direction_power.note: The primary DGP deliberately assumes the DEFLATED Study-4 C-arm point estimate (+0.2449), not the Python-scale effect: after the H-LANG NOT_CONFIRMED, powering the re-test on the optimistic Python effect would repeat the Study-4 design debt. Both legs are reported; the primary leg governs the §4 feasibility statement.

e_mr_diversity.family: MR — H2-4 MR-side diversity (delta_MR = SMS_R - SMS_L, paired on 28 PUTs, frozen v7 pools)
e_mr_diversity.calibration_source: data/results/sms_track2_v7.json + sms_track2_v7_same.json (v7 per-PUT SMS variance; design-from-prior-study, no Study-5 outcome exists)
e_mr_diversity.machinery: normal-approximation MC (same family as power_delta_delta), 40,000 draws/design point, seed 20260708+5; sigma_d = sigma_put*sqrt(2(1-rho))
e_mr_diversity.note: Even at the worst-case rho=0.0 the projected two-sided CI half-width is far below the registered 0.14 equivalence gate, so the H2-4 ladder will effectively be decided by whether the CI includes 0 — disclosed in the registration (§3.4, §4); the 0.14 gate is kept verbatim for form-identity with H2-2 and NOT tightened post-hoc.

f_os_delta_delta.family: OS — H2-3 open-specification source diversity (Delta-delta_OS = delta(open-spec arm) - delta(registered-spec arm), paired on 28 PUTs)
f_os_delta_delta.decision_rule: v1.1 H2-2 VERBATIM three-way (CONFIRM >= 0.20 / BOUNDED_NULL half-width <= 0.14 / UNDER-RECRUITED)
f_os_delta_delta.dgp_source: data/results/sms_track2_v4.json (v4 hurdle DGP — IDENTICAL to the v1.1 and Study-4 H2-2 power runs; power is effect-size driven, not prompt driven)
f_os_delta_delta.empirical_anchor_study4: the Study-4 H2-2 achieved paired CI half-width was 0.0448 (dualblind_delta_delta_v7.json) — well inside the 0.14 BOUNDED_NULL gate; the projection above is therefore conservative
f_os_delta_delta.note: Marginal at n=28 (just below 0.80) exactly as in v1.1 and Study 4; the three-way rule already licenses UNDER-RECRUITED when the CI is wide, so no threshold is moved.
